description: The shared winlog derived layer. Runs after a source submodule (windowlicker's goevtx, log2timeline's winevtx) has mapped its native shape onto the canonical winlog.* model, so it is lane-agnostic: it reads winlog.* and winlog.data.* and projects the event onto ECS (event.*, log.level, user.*, source.*, destination.*, process.*), then dispatches to the per-channel pipeline for the channel-specific extractions. The native winlog.* fields are left in place. The base block here is what applies to every channel: event.kind/code/provider, the Level->log.level rendering, the Level->event.severity bucket (inline), the EventID->message enrichment via the windows-signature enrich policy (elastic/enrich/), and the failed-logon event.reason composed inline from the Status/Sub_Status codes. The lookups without a clean ECS home (privilege names, task category) are not projected; their raw inputs stay in winlog.*.

script.description: EVTX Level -> ECS log.level, the way Windows renders it (1 critical, 2 error, 3 warning, 4 information, 5 verbose; 0 is LogAlways/undefined -> information)
script.source: def m = ['0':'information','1':'critical','2':'error','3':'warning','4':'information','5':'verbose']; def n = m.get(String.valueOf(ctx.winlog.level)); if (n != null) { if (!(ctx.log instanceof Map)) { ctx.log = [:]; } ctx.log.level = n; }

script.description: severity bucket from the Level -> ECS event.severity (critical 4, high 3, medium 2, informational 1); inline 6-row Level-to-severity map
script.source: def m = ['0':1,'1':4,'2':3,'3':2,'4':1,'5':1]; def n = m.get(String.valueOf(ctx.winlog.level)); if (n != null) { if (!(ctx.event instanceof Map)) { ctx.event = [:]; } ctx.event.severity = n; }

enrich.description: EventID -> the event's human-readable description, via the windows-signature enrich policy. The policy must exist at pipeline-create time; see elastic/enrich/README.md.

set.description: ECS message from the signature description, only when the record carries none of its own (Plaso's message is left intact)

script.description: failed-logon reason composed from the Status and Sub_Status codes: each code maps to a phrase, and event.reason is the Status phrase followed by the Sub_Status phrase (or the single phrase when the two codes are equal). Inline 20-code map, collapsed from the 400-row Status x Sub_Status product (every row was phrase[Status] + ' ' + phrase[Sub_Status]); chiefly 4625.
script.if: ctx.event?.reason == null && ctx.winlog?.data instanceof Map && ctx.winlog.data.Status instanceof String && ctx.winlog.data.Status.length() > 0
script.source: def P = ['0xc000005e':'There are currently no logon servers available to service the logon request.', '0xc0000064':'The specified account does not exist.', '0xc000006a':'User logon with misspelled or bad password.', '0xc000006d':'The cause is either a bad username or authentication information.', '0xc000006e':'Indicates a referenced user name and authentication information are valid, but some user account restriction has prevented successful authentication (such as time-of-day restrictions).', '0xc000006f':'User logon outside authorized hours.', '0xc0000070':'User logon from unauthorized workstation.', '0xc0000071':'User logon with expired password.', '0xc0000072':'User logon to account disabled by administrator.', '0xc00000dc':'Indicates the Sam Server was in the wrong state to perform the desired operation.', '0xc0000133':'Clocks between DC and other computer too far out of sync.', '0xc000015b':'The user has not been granted the requested logon type (also called the logon right) at this machine.', '0xc000018c':'The logon request failed because the trust relationship between the primary domain and the trusted domain failed.', '0xc0000192':'An attempt was made to logon, but the Netlogon service was not started.', '0xc0000193':'User logon with expired account.', '0xc0000224':'The user password must be changed before logging on the first time.', '0xc0000225':'The object was not found.', '0xc0000234':'User logon with account locked.', '0xc00002ee':'A security context was deleted before the context was completed. This is considered a logon failure.', '0xc0000413':'Logon Failure: The machine you are logging on to is protected by an authentication firewall. The specified account is not allowed to authenticate to the machine.']; def st = ctx.winlog.data.Status.toLowerCase(); def sub = ctx.winlog.data.SubStatus; sub = (sub instanceof String && sub.length() > 0) ? sub.toLowerCase() : st; def ps = P.get(st); def pu = P.get(sub); if (pu != null) { if (!(ctx.event instanceof Map)) { ctx.event = [:]; } ctx.event.reason = (st == sub || ps == null) ? pu : ps + ' ' + pu; }

set.description: fall back to the event's own Computer for host.name when the parent lane did not set one
set.if: ctx.host?.name == null && ctx.winlog?.computer instanceof String && ctx.winlog.computer.length() > 0
